sources.title: GitHub - patronus-ai/kimi-k3-nvfp4
sources.snippet: On Kimi-K3 that covered every block. exporter/cast_mxfp4_to_nvfp4_offline.py streams shards without ever instantiating the model (a 2.8T BF16 materialisation would be ~5.6 TB). This means we deliberately use none of NVFP4's precision advantages for weights.

sources.title: GitHub - MoonshotAI/Kimi-K3: Open Frontier Intelligence
sources.snippet: Kimi K3 is an open-weight, native multimodal agentic model and our most capable model to date. It is a 2.8T-parameter model built on Kimi Delta Attention (KDA) and Attention Residuals (AttnRes), with native vision capabilities and a 1-million-token context window. It is the world's first open 3T-class model, designed for frontier intelligence across long-horizon coding, knowledge work, and ...
